      background-color: #ffcc99;
      color: var(--text-dark);
      line-height: 1.5;
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    a {

    }

      font-family: var(--font-family);
    }

    /* ========== HEADER & TOP BAR ========== */
    .header {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe2c2 0%,#ffcc99 55%,#f5b87a 100%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border: 2px solid #ff2d8a;
      border-style: outset;
      border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px;
      outline: none;
      margin: 0 0 4px;

        inset 0 -2px 0 #9f1239,
        0 3px 0 #9f1239,

      width: 100%;
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 200;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .top-bar {
      max-width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 1px 5px 2px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: stretch;
      gap: 0;
    }

    .brand-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .logo-box {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0;
      flex: 1.2;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .header-logo-img {
      width: 135px;
      height: 34px;
      object-fit: contain;
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin-right: 4px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    @media (max-width: 400px) {
      .header-logo-img {
        width: 120px;
        height: 30px;
      }
    }

    .logo {
      font-family: var(--font-family);
      font-size: 1.55rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      text-align: left;
      color: #000F3E;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      gap: 0;
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 0;
      padding: 0;

      font-size: 1.85rem;
      line-height: 0.9;
      color: #ff1493;
      letter-spacing: 0;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fff, 0 2px 0 rgba(255,20,147,0.25);

    .logo .lg-mba { color: #1a73e8; }

      flex: 0 0 auto;
      align-self: center;
      background: #00094d;
      color: #fff;
      border: 1.5px solid #ff2d8a;
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      letter-spacing: 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
      line-height: 1;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .hdr-res-toggle {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      align-self: center;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      background: #00094d;
      color: #fff;
      border: 1.5px solid #ff2d8a;
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: 0.62rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      line-height: 1;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .hdr-eye-ico {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

      width: 15px;
      height: 11px;
      display: inline-block;
      vertical-align: middle;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.4));
    }

      display: none;
    }

    .header.ticker-hidden .hdr-res-toggle {
      background: #9f1239;
    }

    .top-nav {
      display: none;
      gap: 4px;
      flex-wrap: nowrap;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      overflow-x: auto;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      padding: 4px 4px 4px;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
    }

    .top-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .top-nav.open {
      display: flex;
    }

    .top-nav a {
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 0.62rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      background: #00094d;
      border: 1px solid #1e3a8a;
      white-space: nowrap;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: all 0.15s;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .top-nav a:hover,
    .top-nav a.active {
      background: #ffcc99;
      color: #000F3E;
      border-color: #000F3E;
    }

    .header .live-ticker {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 4px 0 2px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 3px 4px;
      background: #ffe2b8;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: row;
      align-items: stretch;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .header .live-ticker.yellow {
      background: #ffe2b8;
      border: none;
    }

    .hq-bar {
      overflow-x: auto;
      overflow-y: hidden;
      white-space: nowrap;
      width: 70%;
      flex: 0 0 70%;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-width: none;

          <p>Satta Matka is one of India's oldest and most widely followed number-based games. It began in Mumbai in the 1960s, rooted in a practice where players would bet on the opening and closing rates of cotton traded between the Bombay Cotton Exchange and the New York Cotton Exchange. When that commodity feed was cut in 1961, the game's organizers adapted by switching to a draw-based format. Numbers were written on slips of paper, placed inside an earthen pot called a matka, and drawn at random to determine the result.</p>
          <p>That earthen pot gave the game its name. Matka, which simply means pot in Hindi, became the word that defined an entire culture of number-based play that spread from the streets of Mumbai to every corner of India.</p>
          <p>The core mechanics have remained largely unchanged since then. Players pick numbers, wait for the official result to be declared, and see if their selection matches the outcome.           <p>Today, Satta Matka runs across dozens of named markets, each operating on its own schedule with its own player base.           <p>At its core, Satta Matka is a number-based game built around a simple concept: players select number combinations and wait for the official result to be declared.</p>
          <p>Each market operates on its own schedule and typically includes an Open and Close session. During these sessions, three-digit panel numbers are drawn and converted into single-digit results. The Open digit and Close digit are then combined to form a two-digit pair known as a Jodi.</p>
          <p>For example, if the selected panel is 1-5-7, the digits are added together to get 13. Only the last digit of the total is considered, which in this case is 3. The panel result becomes 157-3. The same process is repeated for the Close session to produce the final result.</p>
          <p>Players can participate through different formats, including Singles (0-9), Jodis (00-99), and Panna or Patti combinations (three-digit panels). Once the official result is declared, players compare their selections against the published outcome.</p>
          <p>While the mechanics are straightforward, each market has its own timings, chart history, and player community. That's why many enthusiasts follow specific markets such as Kalyan, Milan, Rajdhani, or Main Bazar and use historical charts to track past results and patterns.</p>

    if (!mSelect || !sSelect || !listBox) return;

    function isOvernightAM(timeStr, openTimeStr){
      if(!timeStr || !openTimeStr) return false;
      return /am/i.test(timeStr) && /pm/i.test(openTimeStr);
    }

    function checkSessionPassed(timeStr, openTimeStr){
      if (!timeStr) return false;
      var match = timeStr.trim().match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)$/i);
      if (!match) return false;
      var h = parseInt(match[1], 10);
      var m = parseInt(match[2], 10);
      var ampm = match[3].toUpperCase();
      if (ampm === 'PM' && h < 12) h += 12;
      if (ampm === 'AM' && h === 12) h = 0;

      // Current Indian Time (Asia/Kolkata UTC+5:30)
      var now = new Date();
      var utc = now.getTime() + (now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000);
      var ist = new Date(utc + (3600000 * 5.5));

      var target = new Date(ist.getTime());
      target.setHours(h, m, 0, 0);

      var isOvernight = isOvernightAM(timeStr, openTimeStr);
      if (isOvernight) {
        var nowHour = ist.getHours();
        if (nowHour >= 12 || nowHour >= 5) {
          target.setDate(target.getDate() + 1);
        }
      }

      return ist >= target;
    }

    function renderTrend(){
      var m = mSelect.value;
      var s = sSelect.value;
      var mData = trendData[m] || {};
      var openTime = mData.open_time || '';
      var closeTime = mData.close_time || '';

      if (openTimeEl) openTimeEl.textContent = openTime || '--:--';
      if (closeTimeEl) closeTimeEl.textContent = closeTime || '--:--';

      var isPassed = (s === 'OPEN') ? checkSessionPassed(openTime, '') : checkSessionPassed(closeTime, openTime);
      if (statusEl) {
        if (isPassed) {
          statusEl.className = 'dt2-status closed';
          statusEl.textContent = '🔒 CLOSED';
          statusEl.title = 'Market ' + s + ' time has passed. Results are locked.';
        } else {
          statusEl.className = 'dt2-status live';
          statusEl.textContent = '🟢 LIVE';
          statusEl.title = 'Live Digit Trend updating every 5 minutes.';
        }
      }

      var rows = (mData && mData[s]) ? mData[s] : [];
      if(!rows.length) return;
      var html = '';
      rows.forEach(function(r){
        var pct = parseInt(r.pct) || 0;
        var t = r.type || (pct >= 15 ? 'hi' : (pct >= 5 ? 'mid' : 'lo'));
        html += '<div class="dt2-row ' + t + '">' +
          '<span class="dt2-num">' + (r.num !== undefined ? r.num : '') + '</span>' +
          '<div class="dt2-bar"><div style="width:' + pct + '%"></div></div>' +
          '<span class="dt2-pct">' + pct + '%</span>' +
        '</div>';
      });
      listBox.innerHTML = html;
    }

    mSelect.addEventListener('change', renderTrend);
    sSelect.addEventListener('change', renderTrend);

    setInterval(function(){
      fetch('txtdb/digit_trend.txt?_=' + Date.now())
        .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
        .then(function(newData){
          if(newData && typeof newData === 'object') {
            trendData = newData;
            renderTrend();
          }
        })
        .catch(function(){});
    }, 600000);

    renderTrend();
  })();
